explication: Ruby is an interpreted, object-oriented language runtime. The principal workflow is: a user invokes Ruby, initialization enters the evaluator, source is compiled, objects are executed and managed by runtime services, and a value or side effect is returned. The graph also preserves documented capabilities such as garbage collection, encoding, I/O, fibers, dynamic loading, and extensibility. RubyGems and Bundler form a related package-management branch. Some arrows reflect repository structure and README capabilities; sampled excerpts were incomplete.
